recommendation: Keep the no-change audit and treat FHIR-8151 as the source-changing reconciliation for this historical search-capability family. If live-site search endpoint or version-scoping behavior still needs adjustment, handle it under a final later Jira decision.
issue_request: FHIR-5316 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-I change request asking for a way to search across the FHIR specification, not just from the home page, and noting that home-page search returned results outside the developmental ballot scope.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-5316 was found. The Jira comments say it was resolved for another task; subsequent site/tooling history shows specification search working again, and current source later gained source/search-build.html as a build-registered CI search page.
additional_context: The seed is part of the same DSTU1 search-capability family as FHIR-8151, FHIR-7712, FHIR-6849, and duplicate FHIR-7748. FHIR-8151 is already represented on the combined branch by the source fix that routes current search links through search-location, while FHIR-7712, FHIR-6849, and FHIR-11438 already have no-change audits. Later live search.cfm reports FHIR-50549 and FHIR-54549 remain unresolved and were treated as background only.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current combined-branch source includes source/search-build.html in publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml, and the navbar, home page, and footer all route search links through [%search-location%]. A FHIR-5316 edit would duplicate the already-published FHIR-8151 source fix or preempt unresolved later live-site work.
